message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data or parsed arguments anywhere in the visible code.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched via PyG's built-in Flickr/Planetoid dataset loaders with no checksum verification, pinned revisions, or authentication of the remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values, checks label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code loads and transforms graph data without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls are implemented anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or adversarial perturbation methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set being isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics being used to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape, range, or schema validation checks on incoming data before it is passed to the model; the pipeline directly consumes raw graph data and command-line arguments without defensive validation.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibration thresholds before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a graph neural network pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
